title: Pin surefire and keep JUnit at 4.13.2 so the Java 25 build passes
body:
Since #22 merged, master's build fails its Java 25 job, so the "Deploy SNAPSHOT to Maven" step is skipped and `serialization.xstream-api` 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT never reaches mavenrepo.openmrs.org ([run](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-module-serialization.xstream/actions/runs/37613092262)). emrapi's Platform 3 upgrade (openmrs/openmrs-module-emrapi#295) can't resolve it until it does.

## Cause
- `maven-surefire-plugin` had no version, so every build resolves one from repository metadata. In that run, the api tests used 3.5.4 in the Java 21 job and 3.6.0 everywhere else.
- surefire 3.6.0 adds the JUnit Vintage engine whenever JUnit is on the test classpath. `xmlunit-legacy` brings in JUnit 3.8.1, which that engine rejects (`Unsupported version of junit:junit: 3.8.1. Please upgrade to version 4.12 or later.`), so test discovery fails before anything runs: `TestEngine with ID 'junit-vintage' failed to discover tests`.

## Changes
- Pin surefire to 3.6.0.
- Manage `junit:junit` at 4.13.2 for tests. `xmlunit-legacy` still needs JUnit on the classpath, because its `XMLAssert` extends `junit.framework.Assert`.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` with surefire 3.6.0 and without the JUnit change fails the same way on both JDK 21 and JDK 25 (0 tests run).
- With this change it passes on both JDK 25 and JDK 21: 78 api tests, the same 78 the Java 21 job ran, with `junit:junit` resolved to 4.13.2.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates serialization.xstream so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). It is needed by the reporting and reportingrest Platform 3 upgrades. Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Build and versions:
  - Module version is now 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT, `openMRSVersion` is 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and `openmrs-bom` is imported.
  - Builds with Java 21. `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
  - CI uses JDK 21.
- Serializer registration: core removed the `serializationServiceTarget` bean (TRUNK-6361), which made `<bean parent="serializationServiceTarget">` break the module context. A `MethodInvokingBean` now calls `serializationService.setSerializers(...)`, which adds to the existing serializers.
- Hibernate 7 collections:
  - `CollectionCompatibilityConverter` now uses `org.hibernate.collection.spi.*`, and its profile moves from `2.*` to `3.*`.
  - `PersistentBag` (now used for `java.util.Collection` mappings such as `ConceptName.tags`) is converted to `ArrayList`. Previously it recursed into a `StackOverflowError` when serializing a Concept with tagged names.
- Hibernate 7 proxies are `Foo$HibernateProxy` classes. The proxy checks in `CustomJavassistEnhancedConverter`, `BaseShortConverter` and `CGLibMapper` now recognise them. Without this, lazy associations serialized as an empty self-reference.
- XStream 1.4.21 type allow-list: `XStreamSerializer.deserialize` now applies core's allow-list via `SimpleXStreamSerializer.setupXStreamSecurity`. Without it, deserialization fails with `ForbiddenClassException`.
- `User` has declared its own `retired` field since core 2.4, which `useAttributeFor(BaseOpenmrsMetadata.class, "retired")` does not cover, so `useAttributeFor(User.class, "retired")` writes it as an attribute again, as on 2.0 to 2.3. Reading accepts both that attribute and the `<retired>` element the module wrote on 2.4 to 2.8.
- `javax.annotation` is now `jakarta.annotation`. The api module no longer depends on openmrs-web, whose web test context broke the api tests.
- Tests are on JUnit 5. xmlunit 1 is replaced by `xmlunit-legacy` 2.10.4 (same `XMLAssert` API). Surefire passes `--add-opens java.base/java.lang,java.util`, as core's own tests do.
- Test fixtures follow the 3.0 schema:
  - Privilege audit columns and `cohort_member` columns are filled in.
  - `Cohort.memberIds` asserts now check `memberships`.
  - Hand-written XML no longer has elements for fields that core removed: `checkDigit`, `Encounter.patientId` and `Field.answers`.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes (78 tests).
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`) together with legacyui, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, calculation, fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT, htmlwidgets, idgen, event, stockmanagement and teleconsultation:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.

## Notes for reviewers
- XML serialized before 3.0 that contains `checkDigit`, `Encounter.patientId`, `Field.answers` or `memberIds` will now be rejected, because those fields no longer exist in core.
- Deserializing `TreeSet`/`TreeMap` needs `java.base/java.util` opened on the server JVM. Tomcat's `catalina.sh` does that by default.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests
